# `aitbc wallet balance`

Check the AITBC balance of a wallet from the blockchain RPC.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet balance [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | no | Wallet name. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet balance
```
